Leah (CSM): Kicking off Orion Health onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a tight 14-day first-phase plan. Propose kickoff meeting Tues 10am PT and a short follow-up sync at day 7. Who's in for responsibilities?
Omar (AE): Tuesday 10am PT works for me. Who owns SSO and data mapping on our side?
Priya (Customer Eng): I can own SSO (Okta) + integration checklist. Need their EHR schema + a service account/API key to test. @Leah can you confirm the customer contact?
Leah (CSM): Customer contact is Dr. Kline (Orion IT) — I'll DM the details after this. Agenda I suggest: intros, scope & success criteria, 14-day milestones, immediate blockers/reqs.
Sam (Integration Eng): Quick FYI on integration tasks: environment access, webhook endpoint + TLS, test payloads, and a small canary prompt set. Example test curl to hit their webhook:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.orion.example/api/v1/test-webhook -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"patient_id":"12345","payload":"test"}'
```
Sam (Integration Eng): Also we need their test env IPs for allowlisting — Priya, can you grab firewall contact?
Mia (Training Lead): I'll own admin + end-user training. Plan: 2x 45m sessions in week 2 (admin deep-dive, clinician workflow). Will draft a 1-pager admin guide. Any custom fields or role changes we should prep for?
Priya (Customer Eng): Noted. Also need sample EHR schema and a data dictionary. @Omar can you share the doc?
Omar (AE): Uploading schema to the shared onboarding folder now and granting access to the team: https://redwood.share/orion/onboarding-schema (perm: team-view).
Leah (CSM): Drafting success criteria — please weigh in: 1) Full auth flow working in test env (SSO + token exchange) 2) End-to-end generation for 1 clinical workflow with <10% errors on 1k test prompts 3) Admins trained and handed off docs + runbook. Note renewal risk: if initial rollout slips beyond 30 days or we miss auth milestone, flag for exec touch.
Priya (Customer Eng): I'll build the test plan and track failure cases. Suggest reusing our `clinical-summary-v1` canary prompt set from repo to validate output consistency.
Sam (Integration Eng): Model routing plan: start with rwd-instruct-1 for quality; fallback path rwd-small-quantized for burst traffic/cost controls. I'll add these to the rollout sheet with expected latency/cost tradeoffs.
Leah (CSM): Action items summary (assignments):
- Leah: confirm Dr. Kline contact + send calendar invite
- Omar: upload EHR schema + grant access (done)
- Priya: own SSO + test plan; collect firewall IPs
- Sam: integration checklist + webhook sample; document model fallback
- Mia: training schedule + admin guide draft
Please react with a quick :thumbsup: when you're comfortable with the plan.
Omar (AE): :thumbsup:
Priya (Customer Eng): :thumbsup: I'll start the test cases document and tag owners.
Sam (Integration Eng): Added a short risk note to the rollout sheet re: network allowlist timing.
calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled — Tue Mar 24 2026 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Invite sent to participants.
Leah (CSM): Great — thanks team. I'll post an updated kickoff doc in the folder after the invite goes out and link the runbook.
